# MANAGED_RESOURCE_CONTROL_PLANE

A control plane that installs providers and reconciles the resources they define.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-docs -->

Canonically `controlPlane`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.controlPlane`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.
